extra_dockerfile_commands:
# Extend asv_benchmarks.txt with benchmark_sequential entries and save to /opt/.
# lsv deps.db will auto-populate the new benchmark's deps on first lsv_init run.
RUN cp /workspace/repo/asv_benchmarks.txt /opt/asv_benchmarks.txt \
    && printf '\nbenchmark_sequential.SequentialParallelSuite.time_parallel_n_jobs_1\nbenchmark_sequential.SequentialParallelSuite.time_parallel_n_jobs_1_with_timeout\n' \
       >> /opt/asv_benchmarks.txt
extra_entrypoint_commands:
cp /opt/asv_benchmarks.txt asv_benchmarks.txt 2>/dev/null || true
sed -i 's/N_JOBS_MAX = os.cpu_count()/N_JOBS_MAX = min(4, os.cpu_count() or 1)/' benchmarks/common.py 2>/dev/null || true

extra_dockerfile_commands:
# Protect bench_keepalive_loop.py from git clean (it's untracked at base commit).
# git clean -fd skips files matching .git/info/exclude patterns.
RUN echo "bench/benchmarks/bench_keepalive_loop.py" >> /workspace/repo/.git/info/exclude

# Pre-register ASV machine "dockertest" so asv run doesn't prompt interactively
# for architecture, CPU count, OS, etc. on first run.
RUN echo '{"dockertest":{"arch":"x86_64","cpu":"Intel Xeon","machine":"dockertest","num_cpu":"4","os":"Linux","ram":"16GB"},"version":1}' > /root/.asv-machine.json
